body_markdown:
Oct. 15, 2026


— Bank7 Corp. (NASDAQ: BSVN) (the “Company”), the parent company of Oklahoma City-based Bank7 (the “Bank”), today reported unaudited results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. “We are pleased with another quarter of strong core results, including growth in the loan book despite significant payoffs, while also maintaining a healthy pipeline of new loans. The Company continues to benefit from high capital levels, robust liquidity, a strong net interest margin, and excellent credit quality, supported by our properly matched balance sheet and our position in dynamic markets. Regarding the Century merger, we are pleased to report that in addition to receiving all regulatory approvals, the Century Financial shareholders have approved the merger, which is expected to close on November 1, 2026. The merger will extend the franchise into New Mexico and will allow the Company’s proven model to leverage Century’s core deposits to provide a highly accretive impact on earnings,” said Thomas L. Travis, President and CEO of the Company.


For the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the three months ended June 30, 2026:


- Net income of $10.20 million compared to $8.35 million, an increase of 22.25%
- Earnings per share of $1.06 compared to $0.87, an increase of 21.84%
- Total assets of $2.01 billion compared to $1.91 billion, an increase of 4.84%
- Total loans of $1.63 billion compared to $1.60 billion, an increase of 2.22%
- Pre-provision pre-tax earnings of $13.62 million compared to $11.02 million, an increase of 23.65%
- Total interest income of $31.93 million compared to $30.93 million, an increase of 3.25%


Both the Bank’s and the Company’s capital levels continue to be significantly above the minimum levels required to be designated as “well-capitalized” for regulatory purposes. On September 30, 2026, the Bank’s Tier 1 leverage ratio, Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio, and total risk-based capital ratios were 14.12%, 15.18%, and 16.31%, respectively. On September 30, 2026, on a consolidated basis, the Company’s Tier 1 leverage ratio, Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio, and total risk-based capital ratios were 14.12%, 15.17%, and 16.30%, respectively. Designation as a well-capitalized institution under regulations does not constitute a recommendation or endorsement by bank regulators.
